nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Priya is a nurse at a hospital in a big city.
She works at night, from eight p.m. to eight a.m., so her day is very different from other people's days.
Priya gets up at three o'clock in the afternoon.
First, she has a shower and gets dressed.
Then she has breakfast, at four p.m.! She eats eggs and toast, and she drinks a big cup of tea.
After that, she walks in the park with her dog, Max.
At six o'clock, she cooks dinner for her husband, Diego.
He's a teacher, and he works during the day.
They eat together at half past six.
Priya takes the bus to work at a quarter past seven.
At night, she checks her patients and writes reports.
She has a break at two a.m.
She finishes work at eight in the morning.
She goes home by bus and goes to bed at nine.
She loves her job, but it's a hard job.
